config.greeks: paired central difference at sampling.bump on the resolved intraday context; desk theta by a frozen-market roll priced at the same seed
config.point_estimator: none declared: point quantities are uncertified

desk_theta.step: the runtime's default hour, clamped to the current segment

calibration_controls: in-ladder calibration one level down, recorded per quantity
reference_qualification: independent simulation of every case

exactness_bases.decided_at_valuation: the only remaining instant is the valuation instant: its events are decided at the known spot
exactness_bases.single_instant_quadrature: one instant remains: value and point derivatives are single Gaussian integrals, taken by adaptive Gauss-Kronrod quadrature split at every jump and kink, with no grid
exactness_bases.terminated: no contingent claim remains: the value is the pending receivables, discounted in closed form

branches.correction: order confirmed as for geometric, extrapolants do not contract; value: Richardson extrapolant; radius: the whole correction |E_n - v_n|
branches.exact: the last two differences are below the stagnation floor AND the solve names an exactness basis; value: finest level; radius: the larger difference
branches.geometric: the last two differences share a sign with observed order in [1.5, 2.5] and successive extrapolants contract to 0.5 or less; value: Richardson extrapolant (4 v_n - v_(n-1)) / 3; radius: the last extrapolant spread, never below 1/16.0 of the previous spread
branches.stagnant: the last two differences are below the stagnation floor and no exactness basis is named: equal values do not establish exactness; radius: infinite
branches.unbounded: the last difference grew; value: finest level; radius: infinite
branches.uncalibrated: the same rule applied one level down (without the finest level) did not cover this value with its own radius; radius: infinite
branches.unextrapolated: order not confirmed (outside the window, or alternating differences) and the last difference did not grow; value: finest level; radius: 3.0 x the previous difference

ladder_policy.calibration: in-ladder: |value - value one level down| <= radius one level down, recorded per quantity; an infinite radius one level down is no evidence and does not calibrate

reference_error_model.local_grid: (points - 1) / 4 + 1 uniform knots over +/- 15 first-interval standard deviations, nested
reference_error_model.method: backward Gaussian transitions of a piecewise-linear value function of ln S with exact barrier jumps; closed-form expectations; an exact last step with analytic first and second derivatives
reference_error_model.radius: analytical: the exactness basis's own error; calibrated_estimate: the ladder policy's radius plus the residual components, scaled to the quantity

residual_components.roundoff: estimate: roundoff_factor x eps x value span x instants
residual_components.saturation: analytical bound: 4 x Phi(-9) x value span x instants
residual_components.scaling: pv 1; desk delta 1/(S h); desk gamma 4/(S h)^2; desk theta 2/step; point delta E|Z|/(S sd1); point gamma (E|Z^2-1|/sd1^2 + E|Z|/sd1)/S^2, sd1 the first interval's
residual_components.truncation: analytical bound: value span x reflection-principle mass beyond the flat-extended grids

reference_error_model.validity_domain: deterministic Black-Scholes coefficients, discrete monitoring, snowball payoffs without continuous knock-in or Phoenix coupons; every level refines every discretization in play

study.name: snowball-intraday-daily-ki-bsm
study.source_text:
# example/modelvalidation/snowball_intraday_daily_ki_bsm.yaml
#
# Daily-KI snowball on the intraday clock: the first schema-2 study.
#
# Two intraday routes -- QUAD V2 and the two-surface PDE -- are certified on the runtime's own
# resolved context: PV, desk delta/gamma, desk theta, and the point delta/gamma the routes return.
#
# The reference is DETERMINISTIC (study revision 2026-09-18, spec section 6.1's escape clause). The
# pilot showed that the RQMC arm cannot resolve these budgets: its standard errors sit 200-700x
# above a quarter of each cell's budget, and its measured convergence is N^-0.35..-0.5 across the
# payoff jumps, so no affordable path count closes the gap. The reference is therefore the
# engine-independent Gaussian-transition solver on a nested refinement ladder. It states a value
# and an uncertainty RADIUS per quantity (never a standard error), including the exact point
# Greeks, so the point cells are certified here too. A radius says what kind it is: analytical
# where the solve names an exactness basis, otherwise a calibrated numerical estimate from the
# ladder (not a proved bound), calibrated one level down inside the ladder. The RQMC arm stays in
# the study as the QUALIFIER: it simulates every case, and the deterministic value must sit within
# max_z of its standard errors plus the reference's radius, or the case is not decision-eligible:
# its cells are unresolved and feed no aggregate, whatever the candidate says. The qualifier's
# sampling below is part of the certification contract; an amendment may not change it.
#
# Budgets are the frozen engineering tolerances (spec 7.1), unchanged: PV 1e-6 of notional; delta
# 1e-5 floor / 1e-4 relative on delta*S/N; gamma 1e-4 / 1e-3 on gamma*S^2/N; theta per hour
# 1e-6 / 1e-4 on theta/N. Gate values are fractions of each cell's own budget, so the shared
# bounds are cell 1.0 and mean signed bias 0.2. S is the recorded spot_scale. The reference's
# radius may use at most a quarter of a cell's budget (radius_budget_fraction).
#
# Sampling is the qualifier's FROZEN budget (min_batches == max_batches), chosen from the
# independent pilot (seed 20260917): 32 replicates, because few-replicate standard errors of a
# scrambled-Sobol estimate understate its error across payoff jumps, and 32768 paths each, where
# the pilot's one 3.2-sigma disagreement (near_ko_on_ko_day_1s desk delta at 2048 paths) fell to
# 1.3 sigma. Seeds are per-case substreams, so cases share no scramble and neither does the pilot.
#
# This is an offline study (hours: the ladder's finest level dominates). Run it with:
#   python -m quantark.modelvalidation run example/modelvalidation/snowball_intraday_daily_ki_bsm.yaml --quick
#   python -m quantark.modelvalidation run example/modelvalidation/snowball_intraday_daily_ki_bsm.yaml --out output/modelvalidation

study: snowball-intraday-daily-ki-bsm
schema: 2

quantities: [pv, desk_delta, desk_gamma, desk_theta, point_delta, point_gamma]

quantity_bounds:
  pv:          {abs_floor: 1.0e-6}
  desk_delta:  {abs_floor: 1.0e-5, rel: 1.0e-4}
  desk_gamma:  {abs_floor: 1.0e-4, rel: 1.0e-3}
  desk_theta:  {abs_floor: 1.0e-6, rel: 1.0e-4}
  point_delta: {abs_floor: 1.0e-5, rel: 1.0e-4}
  point_gamma: {abs_floor: 1.0e-4, rel: 1.0e-3}

bounds:
  cell: 1.0
  mean_signed_bias: 0.2
  se_budget_fraction: 0.25
  interval_k: 2.0
  envelope_fraction: 0.5
  radius_budget_fraction: 0.25   # the deterministic reference's radius, as a bound (interval_k never multiplies it)

sampling:                 # the qualifying RQMC arm; the deterministic reference reads only the bump
  paths_per_batch: 32768
  min_batches: 32
  max_batches: 32
  seed: 20260918
  bump: 0.01

economic_scale:
  builder: normalized
  params: {notional: 100.0, spot_scale: 100.0}

environment:
  builder: flat_bsm
  params: {spot: 100.0, vol: 0.20, rate: 0.03, div_yield: 0.01}

product:
  builder: equity.snowball.intraday
  params:
    initial_date: "2026-03-16"
    months: 12
    initial_price: 100.0
    strike: 100.0
    ko_barrier: 103.0
    ki_barrier: 75.0
    ko_rate: 0.12
    rebate_rate: 0.12
    contract_multiplier: 1.0
    ki_observation: daily_close

context:
  builder: intraday.sse
  params:
    valuation: "2026-09-10T14:00:00+08:00"   # one hour before an ordinary KI close
    phase: before
    profile: desk
    calendar: SSE
    history_level: 100.0                     # every earlier observation fixed at 100

reference:
  builder: equity.snowball.intraday.gaussian
  # Nested ladder, each level halving every spacing in play. The four finest levels give the estimate; the
  # coarsest calibrates the rule one level down. With 16001 as the finest level two PV cells (the lunch-break
  # pair) held a radius of twice their allowance; one more doubling quarters it.
  params: {points: [2001, 4001, 8001, 16001, 32001], width_std: 8.0}

reference_qualification:
  builder: equity.snowball.intraday.mc_rqmc
  params: {}
  max_z: 4.0

candidates:
  - builder: equity.snowball.intraday.quad_v2
    params: {order: 8, cells_per_sd: 2.0}
  - builder: equity.snowball.intraday.pde
    params: {accuracy: standard}

cases:
  # Interior spot one hour before an ordinary KI close: the smooth baseline every other case is read against.
  - {name: ordinary}
  # Just above the daily KI barrier an hour before it is observed; the value function turns over here.
  - {name: near_ki_above, environment: {spot: 75.2}}
  # Just below the barrier an hour before the close. The fixing is still ahead, so nothing is decided: this
  # is an alive claim whose spot sits under the level it will be observed against.
  - {name: near_ki_below, environment: {spot: 74.9}}
  # One second before the fixing: the transition is narrower than any desk bump; point and desk part company.
  - {name: near_ki_1s, environment: {spot: 75.2}, context: {valuation: "2026-09-10T14:59:59+08:00"}}
  # Intermediate horizons, so convergence in time-to-event is observed rather than inferred from two ends.
  - {name: near_ki_10s, environment: {spot: 75.2}, context: {valuation: "2026-09-10T14:59:50+08:00"}}
  - {name: near_ki_5m, environment: {spot: 75.2}, context: {valuation: "2026-09-10T14:55:00+08:00"}}
  # A simultaneous KI/KO close (2026-09-16 is the sixth monthly KO date); the KO discontinuity sits inside the stencil.
  - {name: near_ko_on_ko_day, environment: {spot: 102.9}, context: {valuation: "2026-09-16T14:00:00+08:00"}}
  - {name: near_ko_on_ko_day_1s, environment: {spot: 102.9}, context: {valuation: "2026-09-16T14:59:59+08:00"}}
  # The same spot on a day that observes no KO: the difference isolates the KO event from the spot level.
  - {name: ko_level_on_ki_day, environment: {spot: 102.9}}
  # Before the session opens, inside the overnight segment: under the desk profile it carries 25% of the day's
  # variance at a far lower rate than a session, and a local theta must stay inside it.
  - {name: pre_open, context: {valuation: "2026-09-10T09:00:00+08:00"}}
  # Inside the lunch break: under the desk profile a low-variance segment (5% of the day over 90 minutes).
  - {name: lunch_break, environment: {spot: 76.0}, context: {valuation: "2026-09-10T12:00:00+08:00"}}
  # The zero-variance control: the same instant under sessions_only, where the break carries no variance at all.
  - {name: lunch_break_zero_variance, environment: {spot: 76.0},
     context: {valuation: "2026-09-10T12:00:00+08:00", profile: sessions_only}}
  # An hour before the last close ahead of the National Day holiday: that close is observed as usual, and the
  # fixing after it lies across a folded overnight of several days.
  - {name: holiday_eve, environment: {spot: 76.0}, context: {valuation: "2026-09-30T14:00:00+08:00"}}
  # The last observation: KO, KI and terminal payoff resolve together.
  - {name: maturity_day, context: {valuation: "2027-03-16T14:00:00+08:00"}}
  # Post-KI dispatch: the knocked-in claim with no KI barrier remaining. The checkpoint covers all earlier events.
  - {name: already_ki, environment: {spot: 90.0},
     context: {checkpoint: {as_of: "2026-09-09", knocked_in: true, ki_date: "2026-06-15"}}}
  # Knocked out on the August observation with a 30-day settlement lag: PV is the pending ledger only.
  - {name: terminated_pending_cash, product: {settlement_lag_days: 30},
     context: {fixings: [{date: "2026-08-17", level: 104.0}]}}
  # A due observation with no fixing supplied: thirty seconds after the close, under AFTER, the 15:00 fixing is
  # missing, so the runtime assumes the latest spot. Below the barrier that is a provisional knock-in, and every
  # arm must price that assumed state.
  - {name: provisional_ki_after_close, environment: {spot: 74.9},
     context: {valuation: "2026-09-10T15:00:30+08:00", phase: after, unfixed_from: "2026-09-10"}}
  # The transition width scales with volatility, so the near-barrier case is re-examined at both ends.
  - {name: low_vol, environment: {spot: 75.2, vol: 0.12}}
  - {name: high_vol, environment: {spot: 75.2, vol: 0.35}}
  # Distinct rate and carry levels exercise the integrated drift in the interval moments.
  - {name: carry, environment: {rate: 0.05, div_yield: 0.03}}
  # Each supported clock, with its coefficients recorded.
  - {name: uniform_profile, environment: {spot: 75.2}, context: {profile: uniform}}
  - {name: sessions_only_profile, environment: {spot: 75.2}, context: {profile: sessions_only}}
  # At the close with the spot exactly on the barrier, under BEFORE: the point derivatives and a local theta
  # do not exist. The candidate must say so, and the reference records them as undefined.
  - {name: on_ki_barrier_at_close, environment: {spot: 75.0}, context: {valuation: "2026-09-10T15:00:00+08:00"},
     expect: {point_delta: undefined, point_gamma: undefined, desk_theta: undefined}}
